lectures.author: Nathan Yang
lectures.calendar_status: available; Spring 2027 dates verified against the official academic calendar and course listing

syllabus.status: logistics, course outline, and dates available; assessment rules pending

consumer_agency_research.coverage: 2023-01-01 through 2026-11-05; union of online and issue publication dates
consumer_agency_research.review_status: incomplete; primarily abstract-based, with selected full-text checks

llm_evidence_revalidation.scope: Recalculation of released summaries; no new model calls or trend refitting. Judge and upgrade comparisons are synthetic.

marketing_dialectics.coverage: Kantian critique and ethics; Hume and Smith on scrutiny; Confucian conduct; Scanlonian reasons; stakeholder obligations and public voice; empirical and industry cases

ai_experimentation_pricing.scope: Evidence-based evaluation of objectives and deployment practices; distinct from judgments of author intent

conformal_prediction.scope: Original deterministic synthetic cases; upstream code inspected but not executed

ai_evidence_evaluation.scope: Original synthetic sources, answers, reference judgments, and grader decisions; optional live-model protocol

clustering_optimization.scope: Exact scalar examples and a fixed synthetic CPU comparison; no reproduction of published GPU speedups or measured customer effects

dose_response.scope: Original synthetic finite-design examples; conditional interval evaluation, randomized-store pooling, and imposed objectives

retail_accessibility.scope: Exact synthetic network and footprint comparisons; selected observed restaurant origins on a frozen later illustrative street network.

anomaly_detection_diagnosis.status: available in M7 with original executed examples and optional ungraded practice
anomaly_detection_diagnosis.scope: Original synthetic monitoring and exact timing/imputation examples; no replication of the source benchmark.

inference_efficiency.status: available in M7 with original executed examples and optional ungraded practice
inference_efficiency.scope: Published decoding and training results are reviewed references. Course programs execute original synthetic cost and service comparisons; no upstream model or benchmark was run.

training_data_mixtures.status: available in notes, Session 11, and optional ungraded practice
training_data_mixtures.scope: Exact synthetic ridge model, imposed paired customer-service outcomes, and independent recalculation of selected published aggregates. Final and selected checkpoints remain distinct. No neural training, company-intent inference, or empirical marketing effect is claimed.

synthetic_consumer_research.status: available in notes, Sessions 5, 7, and 14, and optional ungraded practice
synthetic_consumer_research.scope: Original synthetic text measurement and concept-screening calculations; human-study evidence remains a cited reference. No replication of the private study, upstream execution, or model inference.

research_writing_and_coding.status: Available in M1, M8, Sessions 1 and 14, and optional ungraded practice. Suzuri application tests remain unexecuted.

auxiliary_data_and_bias_geometry.status: Available in M3, M4, M6, M7, Sessions 4, 5, 9, and 11, and optional ungraded practice.
auxiliary_data_and_bias_geometry.verification_scope: Rounded published cost ratios, exact toy-design ranks, closed-form allocation versus an independent numerical search, rounding, and omitted-bias MSE.
auxiliary_data_and_bias_geometry.scope: Original analytic four-profile linear model with invented parameters; sampling cost, normal-equation checks, and omitted-bias sensitivity. No human observations, model calls, or empirical replication.

graph_coarsening.status: Available in M5, M7, Sessions 7 and 11, and optional ungraded practice.
graph_coarsening.scope: Four-zone aggregation and travel counterexample, label diagnostics, existing synthetic retail denominator, and selected published metric comparisons; no upstream execution or empirical marketing effects.

ontology_and_knowledge_representation.status: Integrated into course notes and slides, with original executed examples and public optional ungraded practice

representation_evaluation.status: Integrated into course notes and slides, with original executed examples and public optional ungraded practice

agent_workflow_evaluation.scope: Observed mHealth logging reference for 358 prior-period users, invented checker cases, hypothetical costs, and an optional controlled model-comparison protocol.

representation_alignment.scope: Original synthetic coordinates and local lexical mHealth classification; source-category agreement, not nutritional correctness or neural-state replication.

pricing_competition.scope: Original synthetic two-restaurant model; case allegations, company statements, research results, and agency argument distinguished. No observed restaurant-price analysis or liability finding.

digital_usage.scope: Published geographic indices, original Census joins and descriptive analyses; illustrative source calculation; no private pipeline replication or individual service outcome.

statistical_inference.scope: Observed descriptive mHealth pairs; original known-null store simulations; advertising question for philosophical discussion. No measured AI performance or empirical credit-task replication.

econometric_coding_workflows.scope: Published aggregate reconstruction; original constructed errors on observed mHealth inputs; hypothetical expected costs. No new model-performance comparison.

statistical_claims_and_decisions.scope: Original synthetic experiments and decision examples; reported-table normal-approximation calculations; philosophical critique. No utility-panel replication, verified corporate X post, or established downstream harm.

logic_and_inverse_power.scope: Fixed Gaussian/Wald inverse power from rounded reported SEs; original synthetic counterexamples. No utility-panel replication, corporate X verification, or empirical harm attribution.

institutional_exposure.data_status: Synthetic accounting and two-period counterexamples; actual project histories and household bills are unavailable.
institutional_exposure.claim_scope: A risk to treatment measurement and donor eligibility; no verified contamination or bias magnitude in the original study.

philosophical_arguments.scope: Normative arguments and hypothetical applications; actual suppression of residents' objections and corporate X promotion remain unverified.

pricing_reasons_and_antitrust.legal_jurisdiction: United States federal antitrust; sources checked November 26, 2026
pricing_reasons_and_antitrust.scope: Original synthetic incidence, exposure, demand-completion and invoice examples; reconstruction from rounded published payoffs; philosophical and hypothetical legal arguments. No empirical finding of misconduct or violation.
pricing_reasons_and_antitrust.reasonableness: M9 §§9.34.3–9.34.5: measurement quality, worthy objectives, instrumental rationality, and reasonable justification across personalized pricing, dynamic-pricing communication, and data-center reassurance

analytical_arguments.scope: Original synthetic population constructions and philosophical applications; no new empirical finding of consumer harm or author intention.
analytical_arguments.foundational_emphasis: Kantian phenomena and noumena; acknowledged limits versus unknown unknowns; ontological scope; critiques of empiricism and reduction; ends, authority, and normative reasons before optimization.
analytical_arguments.spectrum: Five qualitative positions applied to particular interpretations, with no numerical distances or author rankings.
analytical_arguments.source_coverage: Selected primary philosophy passages, with reading scope and access recorded in the resource guide.
analytical_arguments.measurement_case: M9 §9.42.4 separates recorded electricity outcomes from household costs, financial exposure, business models, and incidence.

ai_augmented_learning.scope: Rounded published percentages, original synthetic factorial means, and an existing synthetic bill table; no participant microdata or measured course learning effect.

wiki.status: local static HTML pilot available; broader wiki and deployment pending

conflicts_of_interest.scope: Original synthetic feed comparison and philosophical applications; no estimated platform harm, dopamine measurement, clinical diagnosis, or finding of misconduct.
